name: task-pilot
description: Claude Code plugin that keeps tasks (estimate, plan, progress, where you left off) across sessions and tracks the time spent on each one.

scripts.bundle: npm run bundle:server && npm run bundle:hook
scripts.bundle:server: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --minify --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=bundle/server.js --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
